text.file.help: Drop an audio or video file into this window or choose it: the speech becomes text. Works offline.
text.languages.help: Pick only the languages spoken in the file: the fewer, the more accurate. English is always on.
text.listen.help: Say «reever listen»: Reever turns what plays on the computer (video, call, podcast) into text. «reever stop» ends it, «reever cancel» throws the text away.
text.status.silence: Stopped: no new text for a while.
text.status.copied: The text is in the clipboard.
log.text.done: ✓ file to text: {chars} characters in {seconds} s
log.computer.start: 🎧 listening to the computer; ends after {seconds} s without text, «reever stop» or «reever cancel»
log.computer.startUntilCommand: 🎧 listening to the computer until «reever stop» or «reever cancel»
log.computer.done: 🎧 listening finished: {chars} characters, copied to the clipboard
settings.listen_silence_s: Listen to the computer until silence
settings.listen_silence_s.help: «Reever listen» ends by itself after this many seconds without new text. Past 10 - only by «reever stop» or «reever cancel».
home.hint: Say «{wake}» and wait for the signal, or say it all at once: «{wake}, {open} …».
grammar.heading: What you can say
grammar.previewNote: Preview without Tauri; changes are kept for this tab only.
grammar.badFormat: The command returned the grammar in an unknown format.
grammar.confirmReset: Reset wake words and phrases to their defaults?
grammar.wakeHint: The first word is the main one; the rest are accepted as variants.
grammar.keepOneWake: Keep at least one wake word.
grammar.label: Label
grammar.cancelHint: The first word is shown as the cancel command in the examples.
grammar.stopHint: The whole phrase or at the end of a chunk: «stop typing». In the middle of text it stays text.
intent.folder: open a folder on the computer
intent.dictate: dictation: type text into the field with the cursor
intent.find: find a file or folder (choice window)
example.findBoth: files and folders from the disk index; several - a choice window, say the number
example.findFolders: folders from the disk index; several - a choice window, say the number
example.findFiles: files from the disk index; several - a choice window, say the number
example.chat: {label}: opens the chat and types the question
example.dictate: dictation into the field with the cursor (or the clipboard); end - «{wake} {end}», «{stop}» or silence; «{wake} {cancel}» - erase
validation.wake: Add at least one wake word.
validation.id: An intent must have an id.
validation.searchQ: The URL of «{name}» must contain the {q} placeholder.
validation.chatUrl: The chat address of «{name}» must start with https://.
validation.needPhrase: Add at least one phrase for «{name}».
validation.emptyPhrase: An empty phrase is only allowed for launching programs («{name}»).
validation.duplicatePhrase: The phrase «{phrase}» is already used in «{other}».
actions.pick:
Pick an action on the left
or create a new one
actions.confirmDiscard: The action has unsaved changes. Discard them?
actions.target: Target - file path, link, protocol or AUMID
actions.searchHint: For a web search, write {q} - the spoken query goes in its place.
actions.phrases: Phrases ({count}) - captured by calibration or typed in
calibration.title: Calibration
calibration.heading: Calibration «{label}»
calibration.hint: Say the phrase again and again, the way you say it. Each one counts - the more, the more accurate.
appPicker.title: Choose an app
actions.scanTitle: Find programs on this computer and add them as actions
actions.scanTip: Add your programs in one go: Reever finds them on this computer and makes up the phrases.
scan.title: Programs on this computer
scan.hint: Checked programs become actions with ready phrases, no calibration needed. You can edit the phrases later.
scan.noteTitle.exists: There is already an action for this program.
scan.noteTitle.generic: The name is an ordinary word, so it may fire in normal speech. Check it if you need it.
scan.noteTitle.system: A Windows or developer tool. Check it if you need it.
settings.grammarLinkPrefix: The wake word and phrases are on Home,
settings.native_mascot.help: The mascot is drawn without the web engine: it uses less memory and appears faster. Experimental.
settings.native_dialogs.help: The “find …” window and the question before a dangerous command are drawn without the web engine: they open faster and hold no memory. Experimental.
settings.native_main.help: The main window is drawn without the web engine: it opens faster and holds less memory. Experimental.
main.notPorted: This tab is not ported to the native window yet.
settings.fps_limit.help: How often the interface animation is redrawn. On a weak computer, 60 or 30 frames ease the load.
settings.mascot.liteLocked: Not available in the lite interface. Turn it off under Interface to bring the mascot back.
settings.mascot_mode.help: In “During commands” mode the octopus appears when Reever starts listening and leaves a second after the command.
settings.voice_adapt: Fit the detector to my voice
settings.voice_adapt.on: Fitted to your voice: hears {heard} of {words} recorded words (before: {before}).
settings.voice_adapt.off: Not fitted - the common detector is used.
voiceAdapt.title: Fit to your voice
voiceAdapt.hint: Say «{wake}» {goal} times, with a pause of about a second after each, as you usually do. Only the word itself - no commands.
voiceAdapt.adapted: Done: the detector hears {heard} of {words} words (before: {before}).
voiceAdapt.noGain: The detector already hears you well ({heard} of {words}) - nothing changed.
voiceAdapt.tooFew: Heard only {count} words, at least {min} are needed. Say «{wake}» clearly, with a pause after each.
settings.languages.help: English is always on. Other languages need a language pack, downloaded by the Reever installer. One pack understands all of its languages and English words in speech.
settings.languages.alwaysTitle: English cannot be turned off: English commands and names are always understood
settings.languages.needLid: Languages from two packs work together only with the language detector. Run the Reever installer again and tick it; until then only the first language's pack is used.
settings.languages.installer: To add a pack, run the Reever installer again and tick it: models already downloaded are kept.
settings.wake_pause_ms: Pause after the wake word, ms
settings.command_wait_ms: How long to wait for a command after the wake word, ms
settings.dictation_clipboard: No input field - text goes to the clipboard
settings.dictation_clipboard.help: «Reever type …»: the text is typed where the cursor is. If no field has the cursor, it collects in the clipboard - paste with Ctrl+V.
settings.dictation_live.help: Words appear while you speak; what was recognised is refined and corrected later. Turn off to get the text in chunks after pauses.
settings.dictation_punctuation.help: Punctuation marks and capital letters placed by the recognition model. Off: plain lowercase text; marks you say out loud ("comma", "period") still work.
settings.dictation_ellipsis.help: The model puts "…" where your speech trails off. Off: no ellipsis.
settings.dictation_ellipsis_pause_ms.hel: The ellipsis appears only if you stay silent this long after the phrase; speak sooner and it is not added.
settings.dictation_english: English words in Latin letters (Cyrillic languages only)
settings.dictation_english.help: Works only with Russian, Ukrainian and Bulgarian. When the model writes an English term in Cyrillic («харднес»), the dictionary turns it into the English word (hardness). Words with a native ending stay as they are.
settings.dictation_english.inactive: Not active: none of your recognition languages is Russian, Ukrainian or Bulgarian.
settings.dictation_english_level.1: Only obvious English words: exact spellings of terms and long common words.
settings.dictation_english_level.2: Cautious (default): terms with a close spelling; common words only when the match is near-exact.
settings.dictation_english_level.3: Balanced: terms and clearly English common words.
settings.dictation_english_level.4: Eager: also looser matches and short common words.
settings.dictation_english_level.5: Maximum: any word that sounds English and isn't in the Russian dictionary becomes English.
settings.dictation_idle_ms: End dictation after silence, ms (5000 = 5 s)
settings.dictation_pause_ms: Pause after which a chunk is typed, ms
settings.webchat_send: «Reever gemini …»: send the question right away
settings.webchat_send.help: Turn off to only type the question into the chat and press Enter yourself.
settings.confirm_close.help: After «close/kill …» a signal sounds - answer «yes» or «no».
settings.raise_result: Bring the opened window to the front
settings.models_unload_after_s.help: Right after the command, after up to 120 s of idle, or never. While idle only the «reever» detector stays; the first command after unloading takes 1–3 s longer.
settings.local_index.help: Needed to find files and folders by voice. Uses about 80–155 MB of memory; when off, file search by voice doesn't work.
picker.searchPlaceholder: Type a file or folder name
picker.typeToSearch: Type a name - the search runs over all disks
picker.indexOff: The disk index isn't ready: it's off or still being built
confirm.title: Confirmation
settings.voice_passive.help: The first 40 times you say the wake word are kept on this computer, teach the detector your voice and are then deleted. Nothing leaves the computer.
settings.voice_passive.done: Quiet adaptation finished ({goal} of {goal}), recordings deleted.
voiceAdapt.introHint: Let’s tune Reever to your voice. Say “{wake}” {goal} times with a short pause after each - just the word. This takes a minute and is needed once.
home.packMissing: {languages}: the {pack} language pack is not downloaded, so Reever barely understands this speech. Run the installer again and tick the pack.
mascotIntro.1: Hi! I'm Reever, your voice assistant.
mascotIntro.2: Say «{wake}» and tell me what to do: I open apps, find files and type for you.
mascotIntro.3: You can grab me by the head and drag me anywhere.
mascotIntro.4: When I show up is up to you: {settings} → {section}. See you!
settings.mascot_position.placing: Drag the octopus by its head to where it should appear, then press «Pin here».
settings.mascot_position.pinned: Pinned: the octopus always appears at this spot.
settings.mascot_position.corner: Bottom right corner of the screen.
settings.mascot_position.unavailable: The mascot is turned off: choose when to show it first.
log.mic.mutedInWindows: 🎚 the microphone is muted in Windows - Reever hears nothing
log.mic.unmutedInWindows: 🎚 the microphone is unmuted in Windows ({percent}%)
log.mic.volumeDropped: 🎚 Windows microphone volume: {before}% → {after}% - Reever will hear you more quietly; another program changes the volume (for example, Discord auto gain in a call)
log.offline: 🔒 offline mode: web search and web chats are off (zero network traffic)
log.models.lazy: recognition models will load after the wake word or hotkey
log.languages.missing: ⚠ no model for: {languages}. Run the Reever installer again and tick its language pack
log.languages.needLid: ⚠ {languages}: a second language pack works only with the language detector. Run the installer again and tick it
log.models.bufferFull: ⚠ model loading is taking long - the audio buffer is full
log.models.unloaded: recognition models unloaded after idle time
log.anglicismsFailed: ⚠ the anglicism dictionary did not load: {error}
log.lid.unavailable: ⚠ the language detector did not load ({error}): every phrase goes to the first model
log.audioDropped: ⚠ audio lost: {ms} ms - recognition could not keep up with the microphone
log.ready: ✓ ready. Say «{wake}» and a command, right away or after the signal. The hotkey does the same without «{wake}». «{cancel}» stops.
log.noAction: ∅ no such action (add it and calibrate)
log.confirm.noAnswer: confirmation: no answer for {seconds} s - cancelled
log.confirm.unclearWaiting: confirmation: neither «yes» nor «no» - waiting for an answer
log.offline.webSearch: 🔒 offline mode: web search is off
log.offline.chat: 🔒 offline mode: browser chat is off
log.calc.badExpression.private: ⚠ did not understand the expression (private mode)
log.calc.typeFailed: ⚠ failed to type the expression into Calculator: {error}
log.calc.typeFailed.private: ⚠ failed to type the expression into Calculator (private mode)
log.chat.clipboard: 📋 the chat input field was not found - the question is in the clipboard, paste it with Ctrl+V
log.find.any: 🔎 searching for a file or folder: «{query}»
log.find.any.private: 🔎 searching for a file or folder
log.find.indexBuilding: ⏳ the disk index is still being built - try again in a few seconds
log.find.indexOff: ⚠ the disk index is off - turn it on in Settings → File search
log.choice.notHeard: … did not hear a number - choose in the window with the mouse or keys
log.choice.unclear: … did not understand the number «{text}» - choose in the window
log.choice.unclear.private: … did not understand the number - choose in the window
log.choice.missing: ⚠ option #{number} is not in the list
log.proc.notFound: ∅ did not find an open program «{name}»
log.proc.notFound.private: ∅ did not find an open program (private mode)
log.proc.protected: ⚠ refused: «{app}» is a protected system process
log.proc.protected.private: ⚠ refused: a protected system process cannot be ended
log.proc.confirm.private: ❔ confirm closing the program by voice: «yes» / «no»
log.dictation.start: ✎ dictation: speak - text is typed into the field with the cursor; it ends after {seconds} s of silence or «{wake} {stop}» (the text stays); «{wake} {cancel}» erases it
log.dictation.waiting.private: ✎ dictated → ⏳ waiting for an input field
log.dictation.dropped: ⚠ no input field - the dictated text was skipped
log.dictation.clipboardBusy: ⚠ the clipboard is busy - the text is lost
log.dictation.endClipboard: ✓ dictation finished ({why}): characters typed - {typed}; in the clipboard - {clipboard} (paste with Ctrl+V)
log.dictation.cancelledPartly: ↩ dictation cancelled: characters erased - {erased} of {total} (the window changed - the rest is untouched)
log.calibration.start: ● calibration - say the phrase for the action (several in a row is fine)…
log.mic.raw: microphone: raw mode - Windows sound enhancements are bypassed
log.mic.standard: microphone: standard mode - Windows sound enhancements apply
log.mic.waiting: 🎙 waiting for the microphone - Reever will pick it up as soon as it is back
log.mic.defaultChanged: 🎙 Windows default microphone changed to «{name}» - switching to it
